prompts.loadouts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for the equipment-loadouts window of Corps Royaux, a medieval fantasy 2D pixel-art MMORPG. Create one finished square 1024x1024 game interface panel, front-facing, perfectly flat rectangle. Dark warm walnut and near-black leather, restrained gold/brass edging, small royal blue cloth accents and subtle fleur-de-lis ornaments. Rich hand-painted pixel-art finish matching high-quality fantasy RPG inventory interfaces, crisp shapes, no modern UI. Most important: the central 84 percent of width and 84 percent of height must be very quiet dark leather with only faint texture, completely empty for live text, equipment rows and controls. Decorative armory details ONLY in the narrow outer perimeter: an engraved steel helmet at top-center, a sheathed sword along left edge, a rolled belt along right edge, small rivets at corners. Even contrast, readable center. Do not draw buttons, boxes, slots, text, letters, numbers, labels, portraits, watermarks, glow or perspective. Whole panel fills the canvas edge-to-edge, opaque background.
prompts.forge: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final production background texture for an equipment-upgrade crafting window in Corps Royaux, a medieval fantasy 2D RPG. One square 1024x1024 front-facing, flat game interface panel. Match a warm dark walnut armory UI with restrained aged gold borders, royal blue cloth and fleur-de-lis details, polished hand-painted pixel-art finish. Main central 84 percent width and height is perfectly empty quiet charcoal leather, only subtle texture, suitable for live interface text, lists and controls. Decorative elements ONLY within a narrow outer perimeter: a small iron anvil with a golden hammer top-center, tiny orange embers in the top corners, two cool sapphire runestones at bottom corners and thin brass etched framing. No flames or items in the empty center. Crisp readable silhouettes, restrained warm forge glow at perimeter. Do not draw text, words, numbers, watermark, slots, buttons or any inner boxes. No perspective or photograph. Fully opaque, fill canvas edge-to-edge.
prompts.icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production UI icon atlas for Corps Royaux, a medieval fantasy 2D pixel-art RPG. Square 1024x1024 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT background, four equal 512x512 cells in an exact 2x2 grid, each icon centered in its own cell and fully contained within the central 70% of that cell. No lines between cells. Four polished hand-painted pixel-art icons, same scale, crisp silhouettes readable when reduced to 48x48, warm gold/brass, royal blue accents, iron and walnut. TOP LEFT: a steel breastplate with a small royal-blue tabard, representing saved equipment sets. TOP RIGHT: a blacksmith hammer striking a small iron anvil, three tiny orange sparks, representing equipment upgrade. BOTTOM LEFT: a steel sword with a sapphire in its hilt and a short blue magical arc around the blade, representing weapon spell. BOTTOM RIGHT: an unrolled ivory parchment with a royal blue wax seal and one abstract gold rune, representing a bound event. Each is an isolated object, no square backing plate, no shadows beyond its own cell. No letters, words, numbers, watermarks or photographic effects. Transparent pixels everywhere outside the four objects.
